description: This file defines the StandaloneInput class, which extends VirtualInput to provide platform-specific implementations for input handling in a Unity project. It wraps UnityEngine's Input class to facilitate cross-platform input management, specifically targeting desktop (standalone) platforms.

classes.name: StandaloneInput
classes.description: A class that provides platform-specific input handling for standalone (desktop) platforms, extending VirtualInput. It encapsulates Unity's Input methods and throws exceptions for unsupported actions.

methods.name: GetAxis
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified axis, either raw or processed based on the 'raw' parameter.

methods.name: GetButton
methods.description: Checks if the specified button is held down.

methods.name: GetButtonDown
methods.description: Checks if the specified button was pressed down this frame.

methods.name: GetButtonUp
methods.description: Checks if the specified button was released this frame.

methods.name: SetButtonDown
methods.description: Throws an exception as setting button states is not supported for standalone input.

methods.name: SetButtonUp
methods.description: Throws an exception as setting button states is not supported for standalone input.

methods.name: SetAxisPositive
methods.description: Throws an exception as setting axis directions is not supported for standalone input.

methods.name: SetAxisNegative
methods.description: Throws an exception as setting axis directions is not supported for standalone input.

methods.name: SetAxisZero
methods.description: Throws an exception as setting axis to zero is not supported for standalone input.

methods.name: SetAxis
methods.description: Throws an exception as setting axis values is not supported for standalone input.
